# Property Prediction

<!-- Generated by contract_docs.py; edit canonical definitions. -->

Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs
and substitute the returned platform references. The connector generates a readable
experiment name when one is omitted; report the returned name. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll
and inspect all returned artifacts. Never invent inputs or reuse another user's references.

## CDS Property Prediction

Calculate selected coding-sequence properties with the CodonRLBERT property workflow. Product surfaces also call this contract **mRNA Property Prediction**; that name is an alias, not a separate backend.

Exact job name: `CodonRLBERTPropPred`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fasta_file` | string | yes | file | Uploaded file: `.fasta`, `.fa` |
| `selected_properties` | array | yes | value | Select at least one of `cai`, `csc`, `gc`, `u_pct`, `mfe`, `mrfp_expression`, `mrna_stability`, `riboswitch`, `vaccine_degradation`. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "fasta_file": {
      "description": "Uploaded file: `.fasta`, `.fa`",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "selected_properties": {
      "description": "Select at least one of `cai`, `csc`, `gc`, `u_pct`, `mfe`, `mrfp_expression`, `mrna_stability`, `riboswitch`, `vaccine_degradation`.",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "enum": [
          "cai",
          "csc",
          "gc",
          "u_pct",
          "mfe",
          "mrfp_expression",
          "mrna_stability",
          "riboswitch",
          "vaccine_degradation"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "fasta_file",
    "selected_properties"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

### Submission envelope

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.
```json

  "job_name": "CodonRLBERTPropPred",
  "experiment_name": "<optional; generated if omitted>",

    "fasta_file": "<user value; see fasta_file schema>",
    "selected_properties": "<user value; see selected_properties schema>"
  }
}
```

For mode-dependent fields, include the fields required by the selected schema branch.

### File checks

## siRNA Property Prediction

Score siRNA candidates for sequence, duplex, thermodynamic, transcriptome, and miRNA off-target properties, then filter them by GC limits and composite rules. This tool is also labeled siRNA off-target prediction in parts of the inventory.

Exact job name: `siRNA_obj_pred`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input_csv` | string | yes | file | Uploaded CSV with the exact columns below. |
| `min_gc` | number | yes | value | Inclusive minimum GC percentage, from 0 through 100. |
| `max_gc` | number | yes | value | Inclusive maximum GC percentage, from 0 through 100 and not less than `min_gc`. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "input_csv": {
      "description": "Uploaded CSV with the exact columns below.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "min_gc": {
      "description": "Inclusive minimum GC percentage, from 0 through 100.",
      "type": "number",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "max_gc": {
      "description": "Inclusive maximum GC percentage, from 0 through 100 and not less than `min_gc`.",
      "type": "number",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "input_csv",
    "min_gc",
    "max_gc"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

### Submission envelope

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.
```json

    "min_gc": "<user value; see min_gc schema>",
```
